description: This file defines the TwigFunction class, representing a template function in the Twig templating engine. It includes configurations for callable functions, safety options, and associated node class information.

classes.name: Twig inal class TwigFunction
classes.description: Represents a template function in Twig, extending AbstractTwigCallable, with configuration options for safety and node class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TwigFunction with a name, optional callable, and options, setting default options.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'function' indicating the type of this Twig callable.

methods.name: getParserCallable
methods.description: Returns the parser callable if set in options.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Determines the safety configuration for the function, based on options or callback.
